name: groundwork
description: Groundwork — a project-agnostic documentation workflow for software projects.

plugins.name: groundwork
plugins.description: Take a software project from idea to MVP plan and keep its documentation honest: BRD and functional-spec authoring, spec gap-checks, an in-repo design package with ADRs, a machine-readable sprint plan, a go-live gate register, a review gauntlet and drift audits.
